Conformance vectors of the Ecd ID (eid), version 1, copied unchanged from the vectors/ folder of the ecd-id repository
at commit 8518ea79bc11a25eaf66b7fae930fc70f7d5fef0 ("Rename to eid: the package, the module, the crate, the command and
the environment"):

  valid.tsv           valid ids, text and bytes both ways           (spec/id.md)
  invalid.tsv         texts the strict parse refuses, with reasons  (spec/id.md#strict-parse)
  binary_invalid.tsv  16-byte inputs that binary ingress refuses    (spec/id.md#strict-parse)
  lease.tsv           lease texts and their strict parse            (spec/lease.md#the-lease)
  mint.tsv            minter scenarios                              (spec/lease.md#minter)

The rows that name the allocator's writer numbers (lease.tsv, first column "writer") and the stream mapping
(stream.tsv) are not exercised: reqid has no allocator and no stream mapping.

The registry copies, unchanged from the registry/ folder of the ecd-id repository at commit 1fcc0f1 (tag go/v0.6.1):

  systems.tsv         the system registry; read by TestCorSystems
  kinds.tsv           the kind registry; read by TestCorSystems

A COR is accepted from a detached-class system, or from a registered system whose row is not retired and whose (system,
cor) row is not retired. TestCorSystems derives that set from these two files and fails unless it equals the set
compiled into reqid.
